summary: FND-03 Shared contracts package validation: implemented complete Zod schemas and TypeScript types in @flowboard/contracts, Gregorian astronomical calendar and leap year validation, UTC ISO timestamps ending in Z, 16-128 char ASCII idempotency keys, canonical error codes and envelopes, and comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 catalog covering 36 endpoints. All 41 unit tests passed; audited and certified by independent reviewer with score 9.825/10.0.
limitations: Contracts define runtime schema validation and boundary types; database persistence and SQL constraints are verified in migrations.
UI and integrated acceptance remain separately owned and unverified.

evidence.command: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspace @flowboard/contracts
evidence.result: Strict typecheck passed with 0 errors; 41 unit tests passed across 19 suites, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Independent audit score: 9.825 / 10.0.
evidence.environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Node 24.15.0, npm 11.12.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, Zod 3.24.2.
